item.title: Mindset for work
item.description: An important thought occurred to me. There are several projects of which I’m thinking of in terms of “finishing the project”, in a sense that I’m thinking about how all the work has been done and there is nothing left to do. In a way, that is the goal that I have in mind. And I have come to the conclusion that it’s a wrong mindset to be thinking about projects. The reason(s) for why it is wrong are:
